lines.text: In eighteen forty-seven, it took Chambertin's name.
lines.phonemes: ɪn ˈeɪtiːn fˈɔːɹɾisˈɛvən, ɪt tˈʊk ʃɑːmbɛɹtˈænz nˈeɪm.

lines.text: Five hundred and forty hectares, in two communes.
lines.phonemes: fˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd ænd fˈɔːɹɾi hˈɛktɛɹz, ɪn tˈuː kˈɑːmjuːnz.

lines.text: Nine grands crus, and every name ends in Chambertin.
lines.phonemes: nˈaɪn ɡɹˈɑːn kɹˈuː, ænd ˈɛvɹi nˈeɪm ˈɛndz ɪn ʃɑːmbɛɹtˈæn.

lines.text: Eighty-seven hectares. Then, twenty-six premiers crus.
lines.phonemes: ˈeɪɾisˈɛvən hˈɛktɛɹz. ðˈɛn, twˈɛntisˈɪks pɹəmjˈeɪ kɹˈuː.

lines.text: The vines face east, and climb to almost four hundred metres.
lines.phonemes: ðə vˈaɪnz fˈeɪs ˈiːst, ænd klˈaɪm tʊ ˈɔːlmoʊst fˈɔːɹ hˈʌndɹɪd mˈiːɾɚz.

lines.text: About seven hundred and forty millimetres of rain a year. Bordeaux gets over nine hundred.
lines.phonemes: ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd ænd fˈɔːɹɾi mˈɪlɪmˌiːɾɚz ʌv ɹˈeɪn ɐ jˈɪɹ. bɔːɹdˈoʊ ɡˈɛts ˌoʊvɚ nˈaɪn hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: April to October averages just over sixteen degrees. July days near twenty-seven.
lines.phonemes: ˈeɪpɹəl tʊ ɑːktˈoʊbɚɹ ˈævɹɪdʒᵻz dʒˈʌst ˌoʊvɚ sˈɪkstiːn dᵻɡɹˈiːz. dʒuːlˈaɪ dˈeɪz nˌɪɹ twˈɛntisˈɛvən.

lines.text: Red only. Pinot Noir is the main grape.
lines.phonemes: ɹˈɛd ˈoʊnli. pˈiːnoʊ nwˈɑːɹ ɪz ðə mˈeɪn ɡɹˈeɪp.

lines.text: Fifty-eight hectolitres per hectare, at most.
lines.phonemes: fˈɪftiˈeɪt hˈɛktəlˌiːɾɚz pɜː hˈɛktɛɹ, æt mˈoʊst.

lines.text: Test yourself. Three questions. Answers in the first comment.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛst jɔːɹsˈɛlf. θɹˈiː kwˈɛstʃənz. ˈænsɚz ɪnðə fˈɜːst kˈɑːmɛnt.

lines.text: Study it free at open wine atlas dot com.
lines.phonemes: stˈʌdi ɪt fɹˈiː æɾ ˈoʊpən wˈaɪn ˈætləs dˈɑːt kˈɑːm.
